policy: An entry is effective only when a later non-merge descendant commit by the same normalized email contains a valid Signed-off-by and DCO-Attests: <exact target SHA> trailer. The checker verifies target metadata, post-cutoff ancestry, and exact-SHA identity. This is a retrospective DCO 1.1 provenance certification, not a copyright assignment or a blanket exception.
